text.printed:
Hero Action: Exhaust Invest and spend 2 or more resources from your hand → if the number of resources spent this way was:
• 2 — Attach the Yaka Arrow upgrade to an enemy or to your identity.
• 3 — Ready Yondu and the Tahlei upgrade.
• 4 or more — Draw 5 cards.
